subject: general
concept: Committees and Recommendation, Modern India (National Movement )
question: Which Committee among the following was formed in Bombay In March 1919?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khilafat Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After the War, the Ottoman Empire was divided, Turkey was dismembered and the Khalifa was removed from power.
 
• This angered the Muslims who took it as an insult to the Khalifa.
 
• The Ali brothers, Shoukat Ali and Mohammad Ali started the Khilafat Movement against the British government.
 
• This movement took place between **1919 and 1924.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Khilafat Committee:

 
 
• In March 1919, a Khilafat Committee was formed in Bombay.
 
• Thus, the grounds for a country-wide agitation were prepared.
 
• An All India Khilafat Conference was held in Delhi in November 1919 and the call was made to boycott the British goods.
 
• In September 1920, Mahatma Gandhi convinced other leaders of the need to start a non-cooperation movement in support of Khilafat as well as for swaraj.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hunter Commission

 
 
• The government formed a committee of inquiry to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh shootings.
 
• On 14 October 1919, the Government of India (GOI) announced the formation of the Disorders Inquiry Committee.
 
 
• The **committee** was commonly known as Hunter Commission after the name of the chairman, Lord William Hunter.
 
• It also had Indian members.
 
 
 
 
 
• Sapru's report was published in 1945.
 
 
• The Sapru report rejected the proposal for the division of India.
 
• It gave recommendations for the protection of minorities.
 
• Tej Bahadur Sapru was the head of the committee.
